lansync.title: How LAN Network Sync Works
lansync.subtitle: Share patient data across workstations on your local network — no cloud, no latency, no GDPR risks.

step1.title: 1. Set Up a Shared Folder
step1.desc: Point PISUM to a shared network folder (NAS, SMB share, or mapped drive). All workstations on the same network access the same database.

step2.title: 2. A Shared Password
step2.desc: The database is AES-256 encrypted. Set a password on the first workstation — all other PCs enter the same password to connect.

step3.title: 3. Instant Sync Across PCs
step3.desc: Each workstation directly reads from and writes to the shared database. Changes are instantly visible across all connected computers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before subscribing.
faq.q1: Can I change my plan at any time?
faq.a1: Yes — upgrade or cancel your subscription anytime from your dashboard. Changes are effective immediately.
faq.a2: No. All plans are month-to-month with no lock-in. Annual billing saves 20% compared to monthly. You can cancel anytime from your dashboard.
faq.q3: Is the Free plan truly free?
faq.a3: Yes — no credit card required, no time limit. The Free plan allows you to explore PISUM with 10 templates, 50 reports per month, and PDF export. Upgrade when you're ready.
faq.a4: AI Dictation converts your voice into structured radiology report text in real-time. It runs via a secure API — audio is never stored. Your monthly quota resets on the 1st of every month.
faq.a5: All payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy, a PCI-compliant payment platform. PISUM never stores your banking details.
faq.q6: Where is my data stored? Is PISUM GDPR-compliant?
faq.a6: Your patient reports are stored locally on your machine — PISUM never uploads clinical data to the cloud. Account data (name, email, subscription status) is hosted on Supabase with EU servers. PISUM is fully GDPR-compliant.
faq.q7: Does PISUM require an internet connection?
faq.a7: Yes. PISUM requires an active internet connection for AI Dictation, AI Enhancer, and subscription management. While your patient reports and templates are stored locally on your machine, AI features securely connect to our cloud APIs.
faq.q8: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
faq.a8: The Free plan is a permanent free tier — no time limit, no credit card required. Starter, Pro, and Expert all include a 14-day free trial so you can experience the full feature set risk-free before being charged. All paid plans are backed by a 30-day money-back guarantee.
